description: This Java class 'AndroidPropertyFilesUpdater' manages updating Android project property files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It listens for project root changes, prompts the user for updates, and modifies property files accordingly, handling dependencies, target SDK, and other configurations.

classes.name: AndroidPropertyFilesUpdater
classes.description: Manages updating Android project property files, listens for project root changes, prompts user for updates, and applies changes to configuration files.

methods.name: initComponent
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up listeners for project root changes.

methods.name: disposeComponent
methods.description: Disposes resources and notifications when the component is disposed.

methods.name: addProjectPropertiesUpdatingListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to project root changes to trigger property file updates.

methods.name: updatePropertyFilesIfNecessary
methods.description: Checks and updates project property files if needed, prompting user interaction.

methods.name: updateProjectPropertiesIfNecessary
methods.description: Determines if project properties need updating and prepares changes.

methods.name: updateDependenciesInPropertyFile
methods.description: Updates dependency references in property files.

methods.name: collectDependencies
methods.description: Collects dependency directories for a module.

methods.name: updateTargetProperty
methods.description: Updates the Android target property in the property file.

methods.name: getBaseAndroidContentRoot
methods.description: Finds the base content root directory for an Android module.

methods.name: createProperty
methods.description: Creates a property object for the target SDK.

methods.name: toSortedPaths
methods.description: Converts VirtualFile array to sorted string paths.

methods.name: askUserIfUpdatePropertyFile
methods.description: Displays a notification to ask user whether to update property files.
